meta.title: Assign items of 5 PRs together from one page

steps.note: Enable the required PR team filtering configuration before accessing the PR workflow.
Open the Purchase Requisitions screen where the five PRs are listed.
Show only open PRs eligible for item selection.

args.goal: On the Open Purchase Requisitions page, tick one item each from PRs 1006, 1005, 1004, 1003, and 1002, assign all five selected items to Procol Planner User, save the assignment, and stop when the screen shows that all five assignments were saved successfully.

steps.note: Perform the catalog gap of selecting items across five PRs and assigning them from one page.
Verify that the assignment operation produced a success message.
